summary: Argan, Inc. filed a Form 8-K to report the results of its 2026 annual meeting of stockholders, covering three routine matters: election of nine directors, non-binding advisory vote on executive compensation (say-on-pay), and ratification of auditors. Separately, the board declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.50 per share, payable on July 31, 2026. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return other than the ordinary dividend, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. This filing is a routine current report of a periodic shareholder vote and dividend declaration.
